'''Brogon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. While stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], he and many other soldiers turned to extorting the citizens and refugees and eventually defected from the Republic, taking to crime full-time. This caused [[Ariavos]] to put bounties on their heads.
